# MCP Security Scanner

> A Go scanner for Model Context Protocol servers: taint analysis of server source, tool-poisoning checks on tool metadata, live probing over stdio and HTTP, and rug-pull pinning, with SARIF output for CI.

Languages: Go. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner

## Source

- [cmd/mcp-demo-server](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/cmd/mcp-demo-server): Command mcp-demo-server runs the inert demo MCP server over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
- [cmd/mcpscan](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/cmd/mcpscan): Command mcpscan scans Model Context Protocol servers and tool definitions for security issues.
- [internal/analysis](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/analysis): Package analysis is the static analyzer for MCP server source code (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python).
- [internal/cli](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/cli): Package cli implements the mcpscan command line.
- [internal/demoserver](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/demoserver): Package demoserver is a small, inert MCP server used by tests, demos and the planted benchmark.
- [internal/findings](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/findings): Package findings defines the finding model and the catalog of rules every analyzer reports against.
- [internal/lexer](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/lexer): Package lexer turns JavaScript, TypeScript and Python source into a flat token stream.
- [internal/manifest](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/manifest): Package manifest models what an MCP server exposes (tools, prompts, resources, instructions), checks tool schemas against the specification, and pins definitions by hash to detect rug pulls.
- [internal/mcp](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/mcp): Package mcp is a minimal Model Context Protocol client for probing servers over stdio and Streamable HTTP: initialize, list tools, prompts and resources, and run transport checks.
- [internal/plant](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/plant): Package plant generates the planted-vulnerability benchmark: small MCP servers in TypeScript and Python, each with exactly one labeled case (a planted vulnerability or a safe look-alike), plus...
- [internal/poison](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/poison): Package poison analyzes tool metadata (names, descriptions, parameter descriptions) for tool-poisoning techniques: instructions aimed at the model, invisible Unicode, references to credential files...
- [internal/report](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/report): Package report renders findings as text, JSON or SARIF 2.1.0.
- [internal/server](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-security-scanner/tree/main/internal/server): Package server exposes the offline analyzers over HTTP with health, readiness and Prometheus metrics.
